question: The first Paralympic Games was organised by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Italy**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Paralympic Games** which were called "**The Stoke Mandeville Games**" officially first took place in **Rome, Italy, in 1960**.
